children: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates:

The Nifty bulls enter today’s weekly options expiry session slightly on the back foot. The Anthropic IPO has turned out to be a blockbuster one, and has provided some much needed boost for the US futures this morning. On the other side, the sell-off in metals continues.

The US Dollar index has strengthened towards levels of 104, while Gold prices are down to their lowest level since September 2025. Copper prices also are down to their lowest since April. This will once again keep gold financiers like Manappuram, Muthoot, and wires & cables companies like Polycab and peers in the spotlight.

For the Nifty, the index is looking to find support at 25,150 - 25,200 levels, and Wednesday’s low of 25,141 will hold the key. On the upside, sustaining above Wednesday’s high of 25,390 will be the key.

For the Nifty Bank, Wednesday’s low of 61,765, which also happens to be the previous swing high could be a decisive factor to prevent an accelerated fall if any. On the upside, Wednesday’s high of 62,363 will be important to watch. Keep an eye on it stocks as well after the Anthropic IPO.

title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Nifty bulls aim for support at lower levels; Metals sell-off continues
